comment: The chip's 8 built-in palettes, in strap/cycle order. Each channel is two points [x1, y1, x2, y2]: a line from (0,0) to the knee (x1,y1), then a line through (x2,y2) that carries on until it clips at 15. Edit with palette_builder.py, then run `palette_builder.py --write-rtl` to regenerate src/palette_presets.v.
